description: Tamil Nadu Launches 'Nalam AI' WhatsApp Chatbot for Government Hospital OP Booking
body_lead: Nalam AI has been launched by the Tamil Nadu Government to make it easier for patients to book Outpatient (OP) appointments at government hospitals through WhatsApp.The service was inaugurated by Arunraj and is currently being introduced on a pilot basis at the Cardiology Department of Rajiv Gandhi Government General Hospital.With the new chatbot, patients can complete self-registration and obtain their OP slips from home, helping reduce long queues at hospitals and improve access to healthcare services. How to Use Nalam AI Save the WhatsApp number 98192 22999.
